evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present SCLATE, an execution substrate where benchmarks and unmodified agents each add their events to one open event scheduler through an adapter.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The model learns to use both, reading 6.8x fewer file lines with a 16.7-point higher SWE-bench Verified pass rate, and writing richer memory records, while its held-out MetaClaw accuracy rises by up to 11.8 points.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We port seven benchmarks to SCLATE and compare ten unmodified harness and memory configurations head to head on ten models.
